links.outcome: Hallucinations and omissions in LLM-generated ED encounter summaries
links.effect: GPT-4: 33% error-free; inaccuracies 10%, hallucinations 42%, omissions 47%; GPT-3.5-turbo: 10% error-free. Mean potential harm score 0.57 (SD 1.11) of 7.
links.quote: In total, 33% of summaries generated by GPT-4 and 10% of those generated by GPT-3.5-turbo were entirely error-free across all evaluated domains.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of GPT-4 and GPT-3.5-turbo in drafting emergency department encounter summaries from retrospective EHR records, focusing on errors, hallucinations, omissions, and potential harm without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
